b96936f44c93777b.title: Art for a Life Free From Violence
b96936f44c93777b.desc: The Art for a Life Free from Violence exhibit is an opportunity to express and show our reactions to experiences of violence which are often silenced or overlooked. The theme emphasizes the role of art as both witness and reaction. The intention is to demonstrate that art can be a platform for processing experiences and demonstrating care, advocacy, and unity. To see is to acknowledge the reality of harm without denial. To hear is to believe stories as they are shared, without judgment or minimization. To stand with is to move beyond sympathy into collective responsibility, support, and change. Exhibit: 12/4/26-12/6/26 Exhibit Closing Celebration and Awards Night: 12/6/26 2PM
